editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive (1040 BF):
editorialDirective.text: Latest sessions filed! Remi Akamatsu survived an explosive swivel-gun barrel, wore a Sharpie cardboard box over her head to bluff past dungeon guards, and sang the Toad spore shanty while escaping with the Black Crystal! Meanwhile, Sans executed Flowey in Mount Ebott after an Oath of Secrecy with King Asgore and Queen Toriel, and Hjumpik's Feyward session recovered the OC Soul Ring! WAH!
